steps.title: Gear blank and teeth
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as drive_gear.ipt.
Design tab > Power Transmission > Spur Gear: 120 teeth, module 0.8, face width 5 (or sketch one tooth and Circular Pattern 120).
steps.note: Teeth drawn simplified (straight). A real worm wheel has a curved (throated) face to wrap round the worm.

steps.title: Bore
actions: Hole diameter 83 on the centre, Through All.

steps.title: Key slots
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Pattern panel > Circular Pattern
actions: Sketch a 2 x 1.4 slot in the bore. Extrude Cut Through All. Circular Pattern 3.

steps.title: Home mark
actions: Hole diameter 3, Through All, on radius 44 at 150 degrees. Save.
steps.note: At home the hole is over the home sensor. Nothing sticks out, so the gear passes the worm all the way round.
